name: bug
description: Reproducible behavior that violates an agreed requirement.

name: enhancement
description: An agreed capability or improvement with acceptance criteria.

name: documentation
description: Reports, setup guides, architecture or user documentation.

name: area:ml
description: ASR, diarization, emotion, graph intelligence, datasets or evaluation.

name: area:platform
description: APIs, persistence, workers, infrastructure, authentication or CI.

name: area:ui
description: Frontend interactions, accessibility or approved ERP visual design.

name: area:security
description: Privacy or security engineering; sensitive findings use private disclosure.

name: status:blocked
description: A named dependency or decision prevents acceptance; record the next action.

name: status:needs-review
description: Evidence is ready for the other developer to review.

name: priority:p0
description: Critical security, privacy, data-loss or core-availability failure.

name: priority:p1
description: High-impact API, inference, learning or business-logic failure.

name: priority:p2
description: Bounded functionality, UI or performance defect.

name: priority:p3
description: Low-impact documentation, visual or maintainability issue.
